clutch.description_intro: INSANE 1v5 CLUTCH in Valorant! This might be the craziest clutch ever! 🔥
clutch.description_body: Watch as we pull off an impossible 1v5 clutch in a high-pressure ranked game. Perfect crosshair placement and game sense make all the difference!

ace.description_intro: ACE IN VALORANT! We just got a 5K to completely wipe the enemy team! 🎯
ace.description_body: Nothing beats getting a full team wipe with an ace! Check out these incredible moments where we take down all 5 enemies. Pure skill and strategy!

highfrag.description_intro: HIGH FRAG VALORANT GAMEPLAY! Multiple kills and amazing plays in this intense match! 💪
highfrag.description_body: Showcasing some of the best high-frag moments from Valorant ranked. Perfect positioning and aim lead to consistent kills throughout the round.
